roles.use_summary: Used DiffBind 3.12.0 with DESeq2 when n > 2 and an FDR cutoff of 0.1; examined replicate variability with PCA/heatmaps and randomized vehicle/DB2115 pairs as a null comparison. The n = 1 branch uses a separate GoodpeaksScript, not DiffBind.
roles.remaining_scope: The exact count/peak population, formula, contrast coding and normalization require explicit reconciliation. Randomizing pairs does not by itself specify a paired model.
